notes: Read all 30 source lines before porting. signals.ts is non-visual utility/type code (a SignalFieldType string-literal union, a SignalField interface, the static SIGNAL_FIELDS registry, and four pure derived helpers). L10-22 `export const SIGNAL_FIELDS: SignalField[]` ported verbatim — all 9 entries with identical keys/labels/types/units (battery_level %, inside_temp °C, outside_temp °C, speed mph, is_locked, is_charging, is_climate_on, sentry_mode, state) and the 'extensible — add new signals here' trailing comment.
